analysis: Integration of all 26 units: no concrete security regression is established from the supplied evidence. Changes reviewed: (1) firstWithheldReasoningAt renamed to firstWithheldOutputAt in ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift (~1147, 1217), affecting only first-content deadline and TTFT bookkeeping. Encryption fail-closed behavior (T-008), cache scope (T-041) and cancellation (T-010) are unchanged. (2) The weight-hash flow changed. The injectable loadWeightHasher defaults to WeightHasher.computeHash (ProviderLoop.swift ~445). For managed GLM loads, ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift and StandaloneServer.swift (~1964-2006) replace the pre/post-load bracketing hashes with GLM5NextManagedLoad.verifiedArtifactSHA256, with recheck() retained. A new owner-only (0600) VerifiedWeightHashStore, keyed by file dev/inode/size/mtime/ctime identities, lets registration reuse the last verified hash for GLM (Darkbloom.swift ~171-229, StartCommand+Modes.swift 216-217, Serve.swift 108). Tests and the changelog assert that the load SHA-256-verifies every manifest file before serving, and that a same-size corrupted shard leaves the digest nil. (3) PageCache.drop and msync(MS_INVALIDATE) are memory-only and do not change digests. (4) Memory availability under the reclaimable policy counts page cache, which is an availability matter. (5) New typed 400 for unsupported output controls, mapped without echoing content. (6) The remaining changes are test-only, docs or a changelog, and cover GLM forced tool choice and JSON mode with post-generation validation, 422 with no content leak, and OpenRouter reasoning handling. Unverified contracts for follow-up, all in sources not supplied: GLM5NextManagedLoad and requireGLM5NextLoadedArtifact must hash every file against the manifest and bind to the loaded bytes (TOCTOU), and the else branch when glmPlan is non-nil but glmLoad is nil needs checking. VerifiedWeightHashStore internals and permissions, and whether a forged record could skip verification, are unseen. A same-user operator is already adversarial (T-012/T-027), and the load-time verification is the compensating control. The test setters in ProviderLoop+Testing.swift are internal and outside #if DEBUG. The production SystemMemory.availableBytes change, including overflow saturation at pageSize .max, and the production GLM5NextPromptPolicy and ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy that the tests describe, are not visible. The omitted integration replay units are docs and changelogs only.
